sources_quoted.quote: Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.

Sources combine by multiplying the underlying factors (10% + 10% damage reduction = 0.9 x 0.9 = 19% total reduction); applies to percent penetration, cripples, slow resist and to damage amplifiers vs damage reductions.

sources_quoted.quote: the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C; the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to +/-20% at the extremes.

model_from_sources.identity: damage_taken(participant) = SUM over damage events of  raw * m(R_post_pen_and_reduction) * PRODUCT(percent amplifiers applicable to that event)
model_from_sources.magic_resistance_pipeline: R_eff = R * (1 - 0.075*k) for k Vile Decay stacks, k <= 4 (max 30% MR reduction) [S3]; percentage reduction precedes penetration [S6]

amplifier_scope.abyssal_curse: +12%, MAGIC damage only, from ALL sources, on every enemy champion inside the 700-unit aura (not only the primary target) [S1]
amplifier_scope.imperial_mandate_vulnerable: +7%, ALL damage types, from ALL sources, only on a target that has been immobilized [S2]

model_from_sources.composition: the two percent amplifiers multiply: magic factor = 1.12 * 1.07 = 1.1984; non-magic factor = 1.07 [S4, S5]. Additive composition (1.19) is explicitly NOT the sourced rule.

independent_computation.what_is_and_is_not_reconstructible: The coupled-scenario roster definition (champions, levels, ranks, loadouts, fight window) lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/tests). data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json does not contain this scenario. An absolute closed-form recomputation of 3072.3 is therefore not available to this oracle. What IS decidable from the sourced rules is the algebraic structure of the observed change, and its direction.

test_1_additive_vs_multiplicative_amps.hypothesis: C4 switched 1+0.12+0.07 = 1.19 to 1.12*1.07 = 1.1984 on the magic component M
test_1_additive_vs_multiplicative_amps.conclusion: REJECTED. M would have to be 5988 post-mitigation magic damage, but the total post-amplifier damage_taken is only 3072.3, which caps M at 3072.3/1.1984 = 2563.7. The change under test is therefore NOT the additive-vs-multiplicative composition question; that rules out the whole 'C4 broke the composition rule' regression class, since switching multiplicative -> additive would have DECREASED the value, not increased it.

test_2_amplifier_scope.hypothesis: a sub-population of damage events on this defender moved from 'Vulnerable only' (x1.07) to 'Vulnerable + Curse' (x1.1984)
test_2_amplifier_scope.arithmetic: delta = (1.1984 - 1.07) * X = 0.1284 * X = 50.3  =>  X = 391.74 post-mitigation, pre-amplifier damage
test_2_amplifier_scope.conclusion: ARITHMETICALLY CONSISTENT. 391.74 is a plausible share of the fight (total pre-amplifier damage on this defender is 3072.3/1.07 = 2871.3 if all magic, so X is ~14% of it). Two readings: (a) FIX - 391.74 of magic damage arriving from a source other than the item holder now correctly receives the curse, which is exactly what S1's 'from all sources' requires and exactly what a ROSTER scenario is built to probe (see S8: the coupled ledger is the layer that re-prices defenders/sources past the first); (b) REGRESSION - the curse leaked onto 391.74 of NON-magic damage, which S1 forbids.

test_3_vile_decay_ramp.hypothesis: the Vile Decay stack average moved from the 0.8*C constant (3.2 stacks, 24% MR reduction) to the full/near-exact ramp mean (4 stacks, 30% MR reduction) per the S7 recommendation
test_3_vile_decay_ramp.arithmetic: target Ahri L18 MR = 30 + 1.3*17*(0.7025+0.0175*17) = 52.1 (base stats cross-validated in data/bin/README.md: Ahri MR 30/+1.3). m(52.1*0.76) = 0.71635, m(52.1*0.70) = 0.73276, ratio = 1.022906. Required magic share of the defender's damage: 0.0166446 / 0.022906 = 0.727
test_3_vile_decay_ramp.conclusion: ARITHMETICALLY CONSISTENT with a 73%-magic damage profile, and this direction is a FIX (the constant 0.8*C understates the ramp; S7 recommends the exact mean).

independent_computation.resolution: Two of the three mechanisms that can produce exactly +50.3 (test_2 reading (a), and test_3) are sourced corrections that RAISE damage_taken; only test_2 reading (b) is a regression. The decisive evidence is textual rather than numeric: BOTH items in this scenario's name carry the phrase 'from all sources' (S1, S2), and the scenario is a coupled ROSTER fight whose golden leaf is a non-primary defender's damage_taken. The only reason to author such a scenario is to pin that these amplifiers cover damage from every attacker in the roster and every enemy inside the aura, not merely the item holder's own damage against the primary target - the precise surface the coupled ledger owns (S8). Under-coverage of 'all sources' produces a value that is too LOW; the C3 tip value 3022.0 is the low one. The frozen baseline 3269.6 is higher still and is consistent with the opposite, over-broad error (applying the 12% magic curse to all damage types, i.e. 1.1984 on everything), so the trajectory over-broad (3269.6) -> over-narrow (3022.0) -> correct (3072.3) is coherent and matches the sourced rule set at the end state.
independent_computation.confidence: moderate. The sourced rule set (12% magic-only curse on all enemies in the aura from all sources; 7% all-type Vulnerable from all sources; multiplicative composition; 7.5%/stack percentage MR reduction before penetration) is unambiguous and fully pinned by the quoted cache text. The mapping from that rule set to a single absolute scalar is NOT independently reproducible inside the permitted evidence tree, because the scenario's roster/loadout definition lives in scripts/tests. The verdict rests on (i) the exclusion of the additive-composition regression class by the delta magnitude, and (ii) the sourced 'from all sources' scope requirement matching the direction of the change.

notes_and_caveats: Not verifiable from data/ alone: whether the +50.3 is composed of magic-only damage. If a future receipt shows the 391.74 chunk is physical or true damage, S1 ('12% increased magic damage') makes 3072.3 wrong and this verdict flips to old_value_correct. That is the single falsifier for this receipt.

The frozen golden baseline 3269.6 is inconsistent with the sourced rules under every decomposition tried here (it requires either additive composition or the magic-only curse applied to non-magic damage), so the baseline should not be treated as evidence for either candidate.
